name: There Is No Love
overview: The topic 'There Is No Love' is addressed in Scripture by highlighting the profound love God demonstrated through the giving of His only begotten Son, promising eternal life to all who believe in Him. The greatest expression of love is illustrated by the willingness to lay down one's life for others, exemplifying the sacrificial nature of true love. While James opens his letter as a servant of God and the Lord Jesus Christ, reminding believers of their identity and calling, the Scriptures emphasize that genuine love is rooted in Christ's selfless sacrifice and the believer's faith in Him.
